atoms.name: SELECT-FROM-WHERE and bag semantics
atoms.one_line: Rows pass a condition; duplicates stay unless DISTINCT.

atoms.name: Joins
atoms.one_line: Cross, inner, natural, left, right and full outer; count the matches plus leftovers.

atoms.name: Aggregates and NULL
atoms.one_line: COUNT(*) counts rows; column aggregates skip NULL.

atoms.name: GROUP BY and HAVING
atoms.one_line: WHERE filters rows, HAVING filters groups; one output row per group.

atoms.name: Subqueries
atoms.one_line: Scalar, IN, EXISTS, correlated; NOT EXISTS expresses "none".

atoms.name: Set operations
atoms.one_line: UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT remove duplicates; ALL keeps them.

atoms.name: NULL and three-valued logic
atoms.one_line: Comparisons with NULL are unknown; WHERE keeps only true.

atoms.name: Constraints and DDL
atoms.one_line: Primary key, foreign key, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, cascade actions.

atoms.name: ANY/ALL and ranking idioms
atoms.one_line: ALL is the maximum, ANY the minimum; count-of-higher gives the rank.
